title: Flavortown Food Fight

Guy Fieri is challenging America's best chefs to compete in his ever-changing lineup of outside-the-box Flavortown restaurants, from food carts to fine dining; with $20,000 on the line, these chefs will need to be prepared for anything.

As the race to the finale heats up, Jonathan Bennett challenges the final four teams to create terrifying toys and elevated treats inspired by childhood favorites; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which teams earn a pass to the finale.

Host Josh Peck welcomes a team of ghost hunters into one of America's most famous haunted houses where baker Ashley Holt has hidden six secret sweets; if the trio of paranormal experts can divine them all, they'll win $12,000.

title: Sweet Deceit
description:

At the world-famous Magic Castle, host Josh Peck welcomes three magicians to face off against master sweets illusionist April Julian as they hunt for six secret sweets; can these professional prestidigitators spot the deceptions and win $12,000?

Host Josh Peck joins three schoolteachers for a kindergarten classroom's Halloween party, where baker Ashley Holt has disguised six sweets as everyday objects; in the game of trick-or-treat, the teachers have to find them all to win $12,000!

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E10 — From Pied to Fried
In St. Petersburg, Florida, a lights-out spot with righteous ramen; in Lansing, a funky joint frying up everything from wings to pig skins to chicken gizzards; a New Orleans smokehouse sausage meat pies and spicy shrimp boudin.
